question:
47. For a finite set $A$, let $|A|$ denote the number of elements in the set $A$.

(a) Let $F$ be the set of all functions
\[
f:\{1,2,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,2,\ldots,k\}\qquad(n\ge3,\ k\ge2)
\]
satisfying
\[
f(i)\ne f(i+1)\quad\text{for every }i,\ 1\le i\le n-1.
\]
Show that $|F|=k(k-1)^{n-1}$.

(b) Let $c(n,k)$ denote the number of functions in $F$ satisfying $f(n)\ne f(1)$. For $n\ge4$, show that
\[
c(n,k)=k(k-1)^{n-1}-c(n-1,k).
\]

(c) Using (b) prove that for $n\ge3$,
\[
c(n,k)=(k-1)^n+(-1)^n(k-1).
\]
